user.title: Connect to your Sobro device
user.description:
Enter your Ayla Networks credentials.  These are the same credentials used by the Sobro mobile app.

For local/mock-server mode, override the Base URL fields to point at your local server (e.g. `http://192.168.1.100:3000`).
